about: Self-updating list of certs, skills and pay evidence for the Career major. scripts/catalog.py flags entries whose 'verified' date is older than refresh_days, or whose watch_date is near; /program then re-checks them on the web (official page first) and logs changes in CHANGES.md. confidence: official = checked on the vendor's page; third-party = only training/blog sites so far.

entries.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate
entries.why: Your chosen AWS target; now includes generative and agentic AI. Most-recognised cloud ML cert.
entries.note: Beta: registration opened 2026-09-01, delivery from 2026-09-29 ($75, 85 questions, 170 min). GA: 'TBD' on the official page (checked 2026-10-07; the earlier 2027-01-14 in HANDOFF is unconfirmed). English MLA-C01 retired 2026-09-28. Model Monitor and Clarify are closed to new customers; the C02 guide names CloudWatch GenAI observability and Bedrock evaluations.

entries.name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional
entries.why: Professional-level GenAI cert; natural step after MLA-C02.

entries.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
entries.why: Foundational; below your level, adds little next to MLA-C02.

entries.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty
entries.why: Last exam day 2026-03-31.

entries.name: Professional Machine Learning Engineer
entries.why: The other big cloud ML cert; now covers Vertex AI generative AI and Agent Builder.

entries.name: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate
entries.why: Replaced AI-102 (retired 2026-06-30); agentic apps on Azure AI Foundry.

entries.name: Machine Learning Operations Engineer
entries.why: Replaced DP-100 (retired 2026-06-01). Only if you end up on Azure.

entries.name: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Generative AI LLMs
entries.why: Training, fine-tuning and optimizing LLMs; recommends 2-3 years of LLM work, which fits you. The associate (NCA-GENL) is below your level.
entries.note: One source says 'coming soon' on NVIDIA's page: confirm it's bookable before CR130 starts.

entries.name: Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate
entries.why: Popular with data-platform employers; exam changed 2026-03-18.

entries.name: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations
entries.why: Agentic architecture, Claude Code, prompt engineering, tool design and MCP, context management: exactly CR120's content.
entries.note: Launched 2026-03-12. Sources say access is currently through Anthropic partner companies only; a Developer – Foundations cert is also reported. Confirm eligibility on Anthropic's own pages.

entries.name: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer
entries.why: Hands-on (performance-based) exam, so it carries weight; Kubernetes is where most model serving runs.

entries.name: Terraform Associate
entries.why: Cheap, common infra-as-code badge; tests Terraform 1.12.

entries.name: PyTorch Certified Associate
entries.why: New, but aimed at people starting deep learning. Watch for a professional-level PyTorch cert instead.

entries.name: PyTorch distributed training (DDP, FSDP2, torch.compile, profiler)
entries.why: No cert covers it well; advertise with a public training repo and a write-up.

entries.name: LLM serving: vLLM, quantization, Kubernetes deployment
entries.why: The most-asked production skill in LLM jobs; advertise with a benchmarked deployment.

entries.name: Agents: Model Context Protocol, Claude Agent SDK, evals
entries.why: Current agent stack; advertise with a public agent plus its eval suite.

entries.name: MLOps: Docker, MLflow, CI/CD for models
entries.why: Underpins every ML cert above.

entries.name: LLM fine-tuning and post-training (RLHF/DPO)
entries.why: Reported as the single highest-premium AI skill: 25-40% over standard ML engineers.

entries.name: Inference optimization (CUDA, quantization, speculative decoding, vLLM/TensorRT-LLM)
entries.why: Rare and paid accordingly; NVIDIA ML engineers in this area reported at $205k-$331k TC.

entries.name: ML infrastructure / MLOps
entries.why: Roles reported up 41.8% year over year; +$20-40k over generalists.

entries.name: Low-latency C++ (quant developer)
entries.why: Fallback with the highest ceiling: new grads $300-550k at top HFT firms; senior $500k-$1M+ in strong years. On hold: top firms are mostly on-site, and you want remote only.

entries.name: AWS Certified Security – Specialty
entries.why: Top of Skillsoft's highest-paying IT certifications list for 2025.
entries.note: Exam code not verified: check aws.amazon.com.

entries.name: Professional Cloud Architect
entries.why: Second on Skillsoft's 2025 highest-paying list.

entries.name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
entries.why: On Skillsoft's 2025 list; you already have a 2024 course for it, and it doubles as AWS foundations for MLA-C02.

entries.name: Rust
entries.why: Reported $140-185k US and among the top-paid languages (+15-25% over median).

entries.name: Go
entries.why: Reported $120-155k US; the cloud-infrastructure language.

entries.name: C and C++
entries.why: Needed for inference optimization (CR140), quant dev (CR310) and embedded (CR370): the one language that serves three pay paths.

entries.name: Embedded software
entries.why: Median reported $165k (another source $220k): data sources disagree.

entries.name: SRE / platform
entries.why: Median reported $164k (another source $225k).

entries.name: Robotics software
entries.why: Median base reported $128k, TC ~$165k mid-career: below ML engineering today.

entries.name: Baseline: ML engineer pay
entries.why: Levels.fyi ML engineer median $261k (Q1 2026, n=9,517); BLS medians (May 2025): software developers $135,980, research scientists $140,300. Compare every track against this.

entries.name: Quant researcher
entries.why: Base median ~$213k; first-year TC $250-450k at top funds; PhD near-baseline at the top. On hold: top firms are mostly on-site, and you want remote only.

entries.name: Actuary
entries.why: BLS median $125,770; exam-driven credential ladder. Remote/hybrid common: 89% of surveyed insurance/actuarial staff had a remote option; consultancies keep the most flexibility.

entries.name: Exam P (Probability)
entries.why: First actuarial exam; overlaps the Statistics major's probability course. Cheapest probe of the actuarial path.
entries.note: Confirm current syllabus and dates on soa.org.

entries.name: Operations research analyst
entries.why: BLS median $88,940 (May 2025): lower than your current path; useful as a skill.

entries.name: Actuarial work vs. automation
entries.why: Routine reserving, data cleaning and reporting are most exposed; regulatory accountability and judgment least. Shortage reported in 2026, strongest for actuaries with data/ML skills.

entries.name: Patent agent
entries.why: Median ~$124k; engineering/CS degree qualifies for the USPTO registration exam; regulated work.

entries.name: Registration Examination for Patent Attorneys and Agents (patent bar)
entries.why: The single credential for patent agent work.
entries.note: Confirm format, fee and eligibility category on uspto.gov before the course.

entries.name: AI security (LLM threats, model/data supply chain) + cloud security
entries.why: Security hiring +23% with AI security the main driver; AI-security roles at a 31% premium over non-AI security roles (Q1 2026 listings).

entries.name: Distributed systems and architecture
entries.why: Cited with security and ML infrastructure as the most AI-resistant skills.

entries.name: Data engineering
entries.why: Levels.fyi median TC ~$157k; ~$240k at Google/Meta/Apple.

entries.name: Certified Kubernetes Administrator
entries.why: Hands-on exam; the platform/SRE counterpart to CKAD.

entries.name: CUDA / GPU kernel engineering
entries.why: Senior-to-staff GPU engineers reported at $300k-$700k+; kernel development from scratch is the top-paid inference skill, and engineers combining it with serving frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) reported 30-50% above standard rates. NVIDIA median TC $390k. Takes months (C/C++ first).

entries.name: Apache Spark / PySpark (+ Databricks)
entries.why: Advertised floor ~$180k in one analysis of 73k postings that disclosed pay, $50-70k above the market median; Databricks lead/staff base $190-260k. Lower ceiling than CUDA, but quick for an ML engineer (weeks) and pays most combined with ML and distributed systems.
